key_claims.claim: A multicenter radiomics model using contrast-enhanced CT can predict high-grade histologic patterns in stage I lung adenocarcinoma and stratify prognosis before surgery
Node-RADS and ESGAR MRI criteria perform comparably for rectal cancer nodal staging, with an optimal Node-RADS threshold validated externally
Hepatic arterial infusion chemotherapy outperforms TKIs on tumor response and progression-free survival as second-line therapy in advanced HCC after immunotherapy failure
Deep learning model G-PROG predicts 2–5-year structural glaucoma progression from single baseline fundus photographs with multicenter external validation
Radiologist integration of LLM-generated diagnoses improves with high-accuracy models, modulated by reader expertise and displayed model confidence
